description: The file implements a React plugin/component for a floating text formatting toolbar used within a rich-text editor powered by Lexical. It manages the toolbar's positioning, appearance, and interaction with the editor state, allowing formatting options such as bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, links, lists, and other rich text features.

methods.name: TextFormatFloatingToolbar
methods.description: React component rendering the floating toolbar for text formatting, providing buttons for bold, italics, underline, strikethrough, code, link, and list options. It manages toolbar positioning based on current text selection and updates its state according to the editor's selection state.

methods.name: useFloatingTextFormatToolbar
methods.description: Custom hook managing the logic for displaying the floating text formatting toolbar, including positioning, visibility, and toolbar state based on editor selection.
